marketSummary: Indian equities witnessed sharp profit-taking in the previous session as the Nifty 50 slid 450.95 points (-1.75%) to settle at 25,349.65, while the BSE Sensex plummeted 1,483.72 points (-1.77%) to 82,435.99, breaking key short-term moving average supports. Heavyweight private banks and metal stocks led the decline, triggered by Tata Steel's high-debt asset restructuring deal with APL Apollo Tubes and broader risk-off sentiment. Cash markets remained closed on November 24 for Guru Nanak Jayanti. In contrast, Nifty IT (+1.69%) demonstrated counter-cyclical relative strength, while select defence names consolidated tightly around structural support zones ahead of upcoming FY28 budgetary capex deliberations.
dailyFocus: Track the divergence between outperforming large-cap IT base breakouts and vulnerable high-beta banking structures. In defence and engineering counters (HAL, BEL, CGPOWER), monitor multi-week consolidation boundaries and volume contraction setups following recent order flow and delivery timeline updates.

news.headline: HAL Commits to Deliver Full Squadron of 16-18 Tejas Mk-1A Jets to IAF by March 2027
news.summary: Following a high-level review meeting at Air Headquarters, HAL confirmed resolution of all major hardware and weapons-integration issues for the LCA Mk-1A, committing delivery of 16 to 18 fighters to the Indian Air Force by March 31, 2027, clearing significant execution uncertainty.
news.impact: Significantly clarifies execution visibility; sets up a constructive platform for a cup-and-handle or flat base resolution as delivery milestones derisk the backlog.

news.headline: Tata Steel Tumbles 8.4% on Deal to Divest Downstream Tubes Business and Acquire Stake in APL Apollo
news.summary: Tata Steel shares fell 8.43% to Rs 163 as the street reacted negatively to its multifaceted Rs 28,000 crore divestment of tubes/coated businesses to APL Apollo coupled with an open offer and promoter stake buy totalling over Rs 32,000 crore, triggering concerns over capital allocation and cash flow.
news.impact: Violated key multi-week swing swing low supports on record volume, invalidating preceding consolidation patterns and pointing to extended corrective action.

news.headline: APL Apollo Tubes Plunges 21% After Tata Steel Executes Rs 15,510 Crore Deal for 26.6% Promoter Stake
news.summary: APL Apollo Tubes shares dropped 21.28% to close at Rs 1,670 following announcements that Tata Steel will acquire an initial 26.6% promoter stake for Rs 15,510 crore and launch a 26% open offer, while APL Apollo acquires Tata Steel's tubes and colours businesses for Rs 28,000 crore, raising substantial near-term debt and dilution overhangs.
news.impact: Decisive breakdown from its primary base with massive liquidation volume; swing longs should avoid until clear price discovery and support stabilization emerge.

news.headline: Nifty Snaps Winning Run to Slump 1.75% as Banking and Metal Selloff Drags Index Below 25,350
news.summary: The Nifty 50 surrendered opening gains to slide 450.95 points to 25,349.65 on heavy turnover, led by sharp declines in heavyweight banks and metal counters. Domestic markets observed a trading holiday on November 24 for Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev.
news.impact: Broad market index broke below short-term consolidation pivot points; swing traders must tighten stop-losses and demand stricter volume confirmation for fresh long setups.

news.headline: Trent Faces $294 Million Passive Outflow Overhang Following Removal from BSE Sensex 30
news.summary: Trent Ltd will be excluded from the BSE Sensex effective December 21, 2026, transitioning to the Sensex Next 30 index. Quantitative projections estimate roughly $294 million in passive fund outflows during the December index rebalancing window.
news.impact: Anticipated institutional distribution limits breakout traction near upper supply levels, likely confining price action to secondary base consolidation.

news.headline: Shriram Finance Advances Over 2% on BSE Sensex 30 Inclusion Effective December 21
news.summary: BSE Index Services confirmed that Shriram Finance will enter the 30-share BSE Sensex replacing Trent, effective December 21, 2026. Research estimates indicate passive tracker inflows of roughly $369 million into Shriram Finance ahead of the reconstitution date.
news.impact: Exhibiting bullish continuation above short-term swing pivots; sustained passive demand expectations could support continuation attempts toward range resistance.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Fresh Rs 619 Crore Orders, Expanding Backlog Past Rs 70,000 Crore
news.summary: Bharat Electronics secured additional domestic defense orders worth Rs 619 crore spanning tactical drones, communication gear, and electro-optics. This builds on its previous Rs 909 crore inflow, taking total executable order backlog above Rs 70,245 crore with robust medium-term revenue visibility.
news.impact: Steady incremental order cadence keeps the stock's multi-week cup formation intact, positioning it favorably for accumulation on low-volume retests of support.

news.headline: CG Power Inks Five-Year R&D Strategic Collaboration with IIT Delhi Across Power and Semiconductors
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions signed a comprehensive five-year MoU with IIT Delhi focusing on research and product development across switchgear, drives, railway systems, and emerging semiconductor capabilities aligned with its OSAT venture.
news.impact: Supports long-term technology scaling narrative without immediate cash flow changes; stock remains locked in range-bound base consolidation awaiting volume trigger.

news.headline: TCS Rallies 3.5% Leading Relative Strength Outperformance Across Large-Cap IT Basket
news.summary: Tata Consultancy Services rose 3.53% to Rs 2,460 on substantial volume of 73.8 lakh shares, emerging as the top gainer in the Nifty 50 and anchoring a defensive institutional rotation into export-oriented technology majors.
news.impact: Displaying strong relative strength against a correcting market; watching for follow-through above short-term base resistance for tactical momentum trades.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard and Damen Shipyards Partner for Low-Emission and Electric Vessel Construction
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard formalized an agreement with Dutch shipbuilder Damen to cooperate on design and construction of low-emission, hybrid, and electric vessels for domestic and international clients, expanding its green maritime portfolio.
news.impact: Bolsters green shipbuilding credentials following recent keel-laying milestones, aiding long-term accumulation structure while near-term price digests post-Q2 margin contraction.
